subject.title: feat(memorySearch): Support multimodal embedding with gemini-embedding-2-preview

question: Should OpenClaw expand memorySearch beyond the shipped image/audio extraPaths subset, and should that expansion include persisted inbound attachments users ask the agent to remember?
rationale: The remaining work changes public modality config plus durable media retention and remote-upload behavior, which are product and security choices rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Split Modality And Attachment Work
options.body: Add PDF/video extraPaths support only after defining the modality contract, and handle remembered inbound attachments separately with consent, retention, deletion, audit, and upload limits.

options.title: Limit Core To ExtraPaths
options.body: Expand or preserve only explicit extraPaths indexing and leave chat attachments out of durable memory for now.

options.title: Defer Broad Media Memory
options.body: Keep the current image/audio subset and wait for a broader memory-plugin or media-retention roadmap before adding new core behavior.

recommendation.title: Split Modality And Attachment Work
recommendation.body: Add PDF/video extraPaths support only after defining the modality contract, and handle remembered inbound attachments separately with consent, retention, deletion, audit, and upload limits.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision lands closest to the shipped multimodal memory extraPaths feature and public config/docs boundary introduced by the merged multimodal memory work.
